text:
Veteran Nollywood actor, Diewait Ikpechukwu, is dead. He was aged 71.
Ikpechukwu, a former footballer, reportedly died on Thursday after a prolonged illness, according to a family source.
Details surrounding his death were still sketchy as of the time of filing this report.
